State_change_caption: The sequence of images captures a subtle but clear progression in the opening of the coffee bag. Initially, the bag is being carefully held with both hands as the seal begins to part. As the frames advance, one hand retracts, while the other continues the action, pulling the seal further apart to create a wider opening. The methodical nature of the task hints at a routine, possibly a morning ritual. This progression not only reveals the functionality of the bag’s design, allowing for easy access to the contents, but also the user's familiarity with the object, as the opening is achieved with no haste or fumbling.
